cards.name: Lion
cards.fact_ar: الأسد حيوان ثديي؛ الذكر البالغ يتميز باللبدة.
cards.fact_en: A lion is a mammal; adult males have a mane.
cards.fact_tr: Aslan bir memelidir; yetişkin erkeklerin yelesi vardır.

cards.name: Pizza
cards.fact_ar: البيتزا تتكون من عجين مخبوز، وتختلف إضافاتها.
cards.fact_en: Pizza has a baked dough base with varying toppings.
cards.fact_tr: Pizzanın fırında pişen bir hamur tabanı ve farklı malzemeleri vardır.

cards.name: Elephant
cards.fact_ar: خرطوم الفيل يُستخدم للشم والشرب والإمساك.
cards.fact_en: An elephant uses its trunk for smelling, drinking and grasping.
cards.fact_tr: Fil hortumunu koklamak, su içmek ve nesneleri tutmak için kullanır.

cards.name: Apple
cards.fact_ar: التفاحة ثمرة نبات، وتوجد منها ألوان وأصناف مختلفة.
cards.fact_en: An apple is a fruit and comes in different colors and varieties.
cards.fact_tr: Elma farklı renk ve çeşitleri olan bir meyvedir.

cards.name: Football
cards.fact_ar: كرة القدم هنا هي النموذج الكلاسيكي الأسود والأبيض.
cards.fact_en: This card shows a classic black-and-white soccer ball.
cards.fact_tr: Bu kartta klasik siyah beyaz bir futbol topu görülür.

cards.name: Guitar
cards.fact_ar: الجيتار آلة وترية، ويُظهر نموذجنا جيتارًا صوتيًا.
cards.fact_en: A guitar is a string instrument; this card shows an acoustic guitar.
cards.fact_tr: Gitar telli bir çalgıdır; bu kartta akustik gitar görülür.

cards.name: Panda
cards.fact_ar: الباندا العملاقة تتميز بفراء أسود وأبيض.
cards.fact_en: A giant panda has distinctive black-and-white fur.
cards.fact_tr: Dev pandanın belirgin siyah beyaz kürkü vardır.

cards.name: Burger
cards.fact_ar: البطاقة تعرض برجر لحم داخل خبز دائري.
cards.fact_en: This card depicts a beef burger in a round bun.
cards.fact_tr: Bu kartta yuvarlak ekmek içinde dana etli bir hamburger görülür.

cards.name: Dolphin
cards.fact_ar: الدلفين ثديي يعيش في الماء ويتنفس الهواء.
cards.fact_en: A dolphin is a water-dwelling mammal that breathes air.
cards.fact_tr: Yunus suda yaşayan, hava soluyan bir memelidir.

cards.name: Giraffe
cards.fact_ar: الزرافة تتميز برقبتها الطويلة وجلْدها ذي البقع.
cards.fact_en: A giraffe has a long neck and a spotted coat.
cards.fact_tr: Zürafanın uzun bir boynu ve benekli kürkü vardır.

cards.name: Tiger
cards.fact_ar: النمر حيوان من فصيلة القطط، وله فراء مخطط.
cards.fact_en: A tiger is a cat with a striped coat.
cards.fact_tr: Kaplan çizgili kürkü olan bir kedigildir.

cards.name: Penguin
cards.fact_ar: البطريق طائر يجيد السباحة ولا يطير.
cards.fact_en: A penguin is a bird that swims well and cannot fly.
cards.fact_tr: Penguen iyi yüzen ve uçamayan bir kuştur.

cards.name: Banana
cards.fact_ar: الموز ثمرة ذات قشرة؛ يُقشّر غالبًا قبل الأكل.
cards.fact_en: A banana is a fruit with a peel usually removed before eating.
cards.fact_tr: Muz genellikle yenmeden önce kabuğu soyulan bir meyvedir.

cards.name: Strawberry
cards.fact_ar: تظهر الحبيبات الحاملة للبذور على سطح الفراولة.
cards.fact_en: The seed-bearing structures are visible on a strawberry’s surface.
cards.fact_tr: Çileğin yüzeyinde tohum taşıyan küçük yapılar görülebilir.

cards.name: Cake
cards.fact_ar: الكعكة في الصورة مخبوزة ومزينة بطبقة تزيين.
cards.fact_en: This image shows a baked cake with icing.
cards.fact_tr: Bu görselde üzeri kaplanmış, fırında pişmiş bir pasta vardır.

cards.name: Sushi
cards.fact_ar: السوشي يرتبط بالأرز المتبل؛ ليست كل أنواعه سمكًا نيئًا.
cards.fact_en: Sushi uses seasoned rice; not every type contains raw fish.
cards.fact_tr: Suşide çeşnilendirilmiş pirinç kullanılır; her çeşidi çiğ balık içermez.

cards.name: Bicycle
cards.fact_ar: الدراجة في الصورة لها عجلتان ودواسات.
cards.fact_en: This bicycle has two wheels and pedals.
cards.fact_tr: Bu bisikletin iki tekerleği ve pedalları vardır.

cards.name: Camera
cards.fact_ar: العدسة تجمع الضوء لتكوين صورة في الكاميرا.
cards.fact_en: A camera lens gathers light to form an image.
cards.fact_tr: Fotoğraf makinesinin merceği görüntü oluşturmak için ışık toplar.

cards.name: Laptop
cards.fact_ar: الحاسوب المحمول يجمع الشاشة ولوحة المفاتيح في جهاز قابل للحمل.
cards.fact_en: A laptop combines a screen and keyboard in a portable device.
cards.fact_tr: Dizüstü bilgisayar ekranı ve klavyeyi taşınabilir bir cihazda birleştirir.

cards.name: Violin
cards.fact_ar: الكمان آلة وترية تُعزف عادةً بالقوس، ويمكن نقر أوتارها.
cards.fact_en: A violin is usually bowed, but its strings can also be plucked.
cards.fact_tr: Keman genellikle yayla çalınır; telleri parmakla da çekilebilir.

cards.name: Pyramids
cards.fact_ar: أهرامات الجيزة تقع في مصر وتتخذ الشكل الهرمي.
cards.fact_en: The Giza pyramids are in Egypt and have a pyramidal form.
cards.fact_tr: Gize piramitleri Mısır’dadır ve piramit biçimindedir.

cards.name: Eiffel
cards.fact_ar: برج إيفل معلم ذو هيكل حديدي في باريس بفرنسا.
cards.fact_en: The Eiffel Tower is an iron structure in Paris, France.
cards.fact_tr: Eyfel Kulesi Fransa’nın Paris kentinde demirden yapılmıştır.

cards.name: Taj_Mahal
cards.fact_ar: تاج محل معلم رخامي أبيض في الهند.
cards.fact_en: The Taj Mahal is a white marble monument in India.
cards.fact_tr: Tac Mahal Hindistan’da beyaz mermerden yapılmış bir anıttır.

cards.name: Lighthouse
cards.fact_ar: تستخدم المنارة الضوء لمساعدة الملاحة البحرية.
cards.fact_en: A lighthouse uses light to help maritime navigation.
cards.fact_tr: Deniz feneri denizde yol bulmaya yardımcı olmak için ışık kullanır.

cards.name: Blackberries
cards.fact_ar: تُظهر هذه البطاقة: توت أسود عليقي.

cards.name: Stool
cards.fact_ar: تُظهر هذه البطاقة: مقعد بلا ظهر.

cards.name: Toaster
cards.fact_tr: Bu kartta gösterilen: Ekmek kızartma makinesi.

cards.name: Electric_kettle
cards.fact_tr: Bu kartta gösterilen: Elektrikli su ısıtıcısı.

cards.name: Spatula
cards.fact_ar: تُظهر هذه البطاقة: ملعقة تقليب مسطحة.

cards.name: Mortar_and_pestle
cards.fact_en: This card shows: mortar and pestle.
cards.fact_tr: Bu kartta gösterilen: Havan ve havaneli.

questions.tr: Yenmeden önce genellikle soyulan bir kabuğum var mı?

questions.ar: هل تتضمن بطاقتي قطعة لحم برجر؟
questions.tr: Bu kartta dana eti köftesi var mı?
